classification: Directional hotel treasury policy, not a credit rating, forecast or guarantee. Unflagged known currencies use a stable baseline. Historical inflation is context; issuer/convertibility risks are judgement calls.
stable_reason: No heightened-risk flag in this directional policy; hold unless hotel liquidity needs dictate otherwise.

unstable.ZWG: Recent monetary-regime changes and convertibility risk.
unstable.IRR: Exchange controls, multiple exchange rates and convertibility restrictions.
unstable.SSP: Low FX liquidity and depreciation exposure.
unstable.MMK: Exchange controls and fragmented FX markets.
unstable.LAK: Depreciation exposure and limited FX liquidity.
unstable.NGN: Material exchange-rate adjustments and inflation exposure.
unstable.HTG: Political disruption and limited FX liquidity.
unstable.BDT: FX liquidity and exchange-regime transition exposure.
unstable.CDF: Inflation and limited FX market depth.
unstable.AOA: Commodity dependence and exchange-rate adjustment exposure.
unstable.RUB: Capital controls, sanctions and convertibility constraints.
unstable.BRL: Floating exchange rate and fiscal/commodity-driven FX swings.
unstable.ZAR: Commodity and domestic-funding sensitivity with material FX swings.
unstable.MXN: Sensitivity to US trade and capital-flow shocks.
unstable.COP: Oil and fiscal sensitivity with exchange-rate swings.
unstable.HUF: Inflation and external-funding sensitivity with FX volatility.
